name: video-edit
description: Raw footage in, finished edit out — autonomously. /video-edit perceives your footage into a fixed-schema occupancy grid, transcribes locally (no API key), optionally rough-cuts retakes and dead air, plans overlay variants judged by an adversarial critic on cheap stills, then renders contextual motion graphics (glassmorphism + 3 more presets, animated SVGs, SFX) in Remotion and audits its own render. No questions, no approval gates — every call it makes on your behalf is written to decisions.md.
